# Packages whose default GODEBUG differs still share one test binary. The
# binary makes each package's default the one in effect when it is started
# for that package, before the package initializes.

go test -x ./nilpanic ./plain
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/godebug/nilpanic'
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/godebug/plain'
stderr -count=1 'link(\.exe)?"? -o'

# A setting only the start of the program reads keeps packages apart.
go test ./plain ./maxprocs
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/godebug/plain'
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/godebug/maxprocs'
go test -n -c -o $devnull ./plain ./maxprocs
stderr -count=2 'link(\.exe)?"? -o'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/godebug

go 1.27
-- nilpanic/nilpanic_test.go --
//go:debug panicnil=1

package nilpanic

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

var atInit = os.Getenv("GODEBUG")

func TestPanicNil(test *testing.T) {
	defer func() {
		if got := recover(); got != nil {
			test.Fatalf("recover() = %v, want nil under panicnil=1", got)
		}
	}()
	panic(nil)
}

func TestNotInEnvironment(test *testing.T) {
	if strings.Contains(atInit, "panicnil") {
		test.Fatalf("GODEBUG=%q: the default went into the environment", atInit)
	}
}
-- plain/plain_test.go --
package plain

import (
	"runtime"
	"testing"
)

func TestPanicNil(test *testing.T) {
	defer func() {
		if _, ok := recover().(*runtime.PanicNilError); !ok {
			test.Fatal("recover() is not a *runtime.PanicNilError: panicnil=1 reached this package")
		}
	}()
	panic(nil)
}
-- maxprocs/maxprocs_test.go --
//go:debug updatemaxprocs=0

package maxprocs

import "testing"

func TestNothing(test *testing.T) {}
